descriptions.text: Scroll of Build Trench. Boy, I hope you’re up on your knowledge of the fighting techniques of the first world war. Allows for the placement of a permanent trench two point three meters deep and two meters wide. Length of trench is variable based on user’s intelligence plus strength. Combine scrolls to add reinforced sleeping quarters and other front-line accessories.

recap.text: Carl finds five Scrolls of Build Trench in a Silver Spam box, each laying a permanent trench two point three metres deep and two wide, and puts them away. Seeing the stairwell doorways break, he asks everyone about their scrolls: he has about fifty, Mandla a ton. He orders a tunnel dug beneath the stairwell chamber. Elle asks if it is sure. It is a theory, Carl admits.

Carl reads a Build Trench scroll in an unprotected crater, after telling the band to keep back. He turns the translucent line ninety degrees so it meets the enemy trench in a T, then answers Yes to Enjoin and Yes to Dig. A Saccathian soldier drops as the ground vanishes under him, and soldiers in other craters cut their own channels past most of the enemy's protections.

beats.headline: Five in a Silver Spam box
beats.text: Donut's rewards are mostly card moves from her first and last fights; Carl's are mostly bronze adventurer boxes. The Silver Spam box holds a pile of scrolls, five Scrolls of Build Trench, its description hoping he is up on the fighting techniques of the first world war. Each lays a permanent trench two point three metres deep and two wide, its length set by his intelligence plus strength, and scrolls combine into reinforced sleeping quarters and other front-line accessories. He puts them away and waits for the Prepotente box to open.
beats.gist: Carl's Silver Spam box holds five Scrolls of Build Trench, each laying a permanent trench.

beats.headline: Fifty of them
beats.text: The stairwell doorways are breaking, and the game is balancing that unfairness in a really messed-up way. Carl sees it now. He asks everybody who can hear him whether they have been getting Build Trench scrolls in their inventories; he has about fifty. Mandla has a ton of them too, and Louis says they are like the bandages and torches on the first floor.
beats.gist: Carl finds he has about fifty Build Trench scrolls, and Mandla and Louis report the same glut.

beats.headline: Tunnel under the chamber
beats.text: Carl's instructions go out to everybody who has lost a key: clear the stairwell chamber of debris and isolate it, nothing on it, above it or around it, and blow it up fast if need be. Then find a Build Trench scroll and tunnel underneath the chamber, with room for the whole party under the room. Mordecai is to put the satchel bombs from Carl's studio on the market for the demolition. Elle asks whether this is a sure thing. It is a theory, Carl admits, not a sure thing.
beats.gist: Carl has the keyless tunnel under the stairwell chamber, calling the plan a theory.

beats.headline: A labyrinth on the front
beats.text: Literal thousands of Build Trench scrolls, collected on the previous floor, have made a labyrinth of trenches along the front: traps and soldiers, fortified bunkers, hospitals, fall-back positions and more. No Man's Land between the two lines is only about two hundred and fifty metres. The forward-most trench is about twelve feet deep, with scaffolding at the front so soldiers can engage the enemy, and red-tinged mud in the bottom that smells of smoke and earth and sweat.
beats.gist: Thousands of Build Trench scrolls have dug a labyrinth of trenches along the front.

beats.headline: Into the enemy's trench
beats.text: Caught in an unprotected crater, Carl tells the band to keep back and reads a scroll. It takes about ten seconds. A translucent line appears with a map, and he turns it ninety degrees so it meets the enemy trench in a T. Enjoin? Yes. His elevation is lower; proceed? Yes, and Dig. At the end of the new channel a Saccathian soldier drops as the ground disappears beneath him. All around, soldiers in other craters do the same with their own scrolls, cutting into the enemy trenches and past most of the protections.
beats.gist: Carl reads a scroll in an open crater and digs a trench that drops a Saccathian soldier.
